title: Driver file front matter
description: The front matter of one driver file in design/drivers/ (#3148, ws-082): contracts grouped under one intent. The Markdown body after the front matter is the design notes. Values stay within what YAML and JSON share.

schema.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only by a change to this schema.

id.description: Stable id: D, a dash and three or more digits, as studio numbers its drivers. Never reused, never renumbered.

intent.description: What the member contracts add up to once all of them hold, in a sentence or two.

members.description: The contracts the driver groups, by id. May be empty while the driver is being planned.
